title: CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Repair Terms: Written Quotes, Approval Period, Billing and Warranty
content:
Repairs of instruments covered by the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan are quoted, approved, billed and warranted on the following terms.

## Terms

(a) A repair estimated at or below the tier's repair quote threshold is performed without a quote; above it Corbett issues a written quote and repairs only after the customer approves it.

(b) The customer's approval counts only when it is given no later than the tier's repair quote validity in calendar days after the quote date.

(c) Count calendar days starting the day after the quote date; an approval on the last day counts, and an unanswered quote is decided expired on the day after and the instrument is returned unrepaired.

(d) Approving or declining a quote is the customer's own decision.

(e) Repair labor is billed at the tier's repair labor rate per hour and parts at list less the tier's repair parts discount percent; a completed repair is warranted for the tier's repair warranty in days, and a warranty repair is not billed.

(f) An instrument found beyond economical repair carries the tier's beyond-repair evaluation fee, and the tier's disposal fee when the customer asks Corbett to dispose of it; a declined or expired quote carries the evaluation fee only when the instrument is beyond economical repair.

## The quote period

- The clock starts from the quote date shown on the written repair quote (CRQ-...) in the company's records; the decision is matched to that same quote.
- Day 1 is the calendar day after the quote date; the last day of the period is the day whose count equals the tier's validity period. Calendar days are counted, not business days.
- An approval given on any day up to and including the last day counts. An approval given after the last day does not count.
- A quote with no answer by the end of the last day is decided expired on the following day, and the instrument is returned unrepaired.

**Boundary illustration (hypothetical validity of 30 calendar days, quote dated 1 June)**

| Date of the customer's approval | Day of the count | Approval counts |
|---|---|---|
| 30 June | day 29 | yes |
| 1 July | day 30, the last day | yes |
| 2 July | day 31 | no |

With no answer, the same quote is decided expired on 2 July and the instrument is returned unrepaired.

## Estimate at the threshold (hypothetical threshold of 250.00)

| Repair estimate | Written quote |
|---|---|
| 250.00 | not required; the repair is performed without a quote |
| 250.01 | required; repair only after the customer approves it |

## Charges on a quote that is not approved

| Outcome of the quote | Instrument beyond economical repair | Evaluation fee |
|---|---|---|
| declined | yes | carried |
| declined | no | not carried |
| expired | yes | carried |
| expired | no | not carried |

The disposal fee is added when the customer asks Corbett to dispose of an instrument found beyond economical repair.
